content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe provide a familiar interface for selling digital products, but their reach is limited. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many creators without access. PayPal, while more widely known, has its own issues, including account suspensions that can tie up funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. In contrast, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that eliminates these restrictions. With solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a fully operational online store with crypto payment processing, ensuring you can start selling your ebooks immediately and keep all your earnings.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional payment processors often impose geographical restrictions that result in many creators being locked out of online selling. For example, PayPal and Stripe do not offer services in many African and South Asian countries, effectively excluding creators from those regions. In contrast, COREMERCH’s sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed specifically for the global creator economy, allowing you to establish a digital storefront without the fear of service denial. This means you can continue to operate and scale your business regardless of your geographical location, making it a more inclusive and sustainable solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, traditional platforms often come with hidden fees and delays. PayPal, for example, can hold your funds for extended periods during verification processes, causing cash flow issues for creators. Stripe charges transaction fees that may seem nominal but can add up significantly over time. COREMERCH employs NOWPayments, which offers automatic crypto payment verification with a low 0.5% fee and no hold on funds. This translates to faster access to your earnings and a clearer understanding of costs, making it a superior choice for anyone selling digital products.
Eliminate restrictions and take control of your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the major drawbacks of using traditional platforms is the lack of true ownership over your digital assets. With PayPal or Stripe, you remain tethered to their systems, risking access loss due to account issues. In contrast, COREMERCH provides full ownership of your online store and customer data after deployment. You control everything from the hosting environment to payment processing, with automation features ensuring instant product delivery upon payment confirmation. This autonomy not only builds trust with your customers but also allows you to innovate and adapt your offerings without restriction.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between traditional payment processors and sovereign commerce infrastructure boils down to your specific needs as a creator. If you prioritize autonomy, faster payments, and the ability to serve customers globally without restriction, COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is the ideal solution. It allows for quick deployment and includes features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. Alternatively, if you prefer a more conventional approach despite its limitations, you may find yourself increasingly frustrated as your business grows. Making the switch to sovereign infrastructure is not just a choice; it’s a strategic move towards financial independence.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Experience instant product delivery and keep all your earnings.
